title: Athlete of the Week: Kennedy Kaiser - NewsBreak
text:
By Sam Rabadi No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
MCALLEN, Texas ( ValleyCentral ) — Perfection is hard to attain but with every passing day McAllen Memorial girls soccer gets closer to it. Their leader, senior Kennedy Kaiser.
“Just being able to come out here and put in the work and have our coach support us and have all of our parents and teammates and the athletic staff, it’s just something that’s really special,” Kennedy Kaiser McAllen Memorial Senior Forward said. “We want to make sure that we try to make this year as special as we can.”
Kaiser is unstoppable every time she steps on the pitch. She is the most prolific goal scorer in RGV history. With nearly 200 finding the back of the net.
“So being here with the team that wants to show up and put in the work every day, that’s definitely made a big difference in me being able to achieve what I have,” Kaiser said.
Kennedy started playing soccer when she was about four years old. Few can say they’ve seen her rise quite like her coach Matthew Kaiser – whose also her father.
“When she moved out of that little girl stage of just loving it and really being competitive,” Matthew Kaiser Kennedy’s Father said. “You know, I got big eyes and I got excited to one day be her coach and hopefully, you know, help her make some history.”
With history already made the father daughter duo is something Kennedy cherishes.
“I wouldn’t trade it for the world,” Kennedy said. “You know, I really feel like he’s a a great coach. He knows how to build us up and how to make us better players and people, and I just enjoy being here and doing it with him.”
The senior knows this is her last ride with the Mustangs. Come next season – it’s boomer sooner.
“Being able to play in the SEC, you know, such a competitive conference,” Kennedy said. “I’m really excited to be surrounded by such great players and I feel like being at Oklahoma, I’ll just be able to be pushed to my potential.”
As Memorial chases perfection to end its season — Kennedy has her team believing anything is possible.
